site.name: moonlight-tickets
site.summary: moonlight-tickets-clone Fictional independent live-music ticketing platform "MoonlightTickets". Dark after-dark theme. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Discovery page: "Tonight" 4 large cards + 4-axis filters (date / genre / venue / price) + "This week" 12-event grid of fictional shows | | `event.html` | Event detail: title, time, venue, doors; favorite / share; artist bio + 3 audio clips; 3 tier cards (Early Bird / Standard / VIP with stepper -/+, VIP shows a "SELLING FAST" badge); right-side sticky order summary with fee preview; venue GA sketch SVG; accessibility notes; 3 related events | | `checkout.html` | Top 10-minute reservation countdown (<1m red pulse); collapsible cart; one accordion attendee form per ticket (First / Last / Email / e-delivery toggle, VIP adds "Name for signed poster", non-first ticket includes Copy buyer info); 3 payment methods + card-number formatting; promo (DOORS5 / TONIGHT10); right-side detailed fee breakdown (subtotal + $3.50 service × n + $2 facility × n + 3% + $0.30 processing + promo discount); Cancel second-confirmation |

run_plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full moonlight-tickets system, prioritizing the primary checkout/booking flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
run_plan.summary: The run will proceed from the discovery page (index.html) through event selection (event.html), ticket configuration, and the complex checkout process (checkout.html), ending at confirmation. It will specifically validate the 4-axis filtering logic, the dynamic pricing/fee calculations in the sticky order summary, and the attendee form behaviors (copying info, VIP fields). Finally, it will repeat critical path checks on mobile to address known tap-target risks.
assumptions: The 'Continue to checkout' button on event.html transitions directly to checkout.html with cart state preserved.
Promo codes DOORS5 and TONIGHT10 are valid and trigger immediate fee recalculation.
The 10-minute reservation countdown on checkout.html is a visual timer that does not actually expire during the test session.
risk_hotspots: checkout.html: Fee breakdown accuracy (service + facility + processing + promo)
checkout.html: Attendee form 'Copy buyer info' functionality for multi-ticket orders
checkout.html: VIP tier specific fields (Signed poster name) appearing/disappearing
index.html & event.html: Small tap targets (<44px) identified in prescan layout warnings
event.html: Sticky order summary synchronization with ticket stepper changes

phases.title: Discovery & Filtering
phases.objective: Validate the homepage layout, navigation, and the 4-axis filtering system (Date, Genre, Venue, Price).
key_checks: Verify visibility of 'Tonight' cards vs 'This week' grid.
Interact with all 4 filter dropdowns to ensure options load.
Apply a combined filter (e.g., Genre: Jazz + Venue: Coppergate Hall) and verify results update.
Check navigation links (Calendar, Venues, Artists) for validity or placeholder behavior.
exit_criteria: Filters applied and results visibly changed.
At least one event card clicked to transition to event.html.

phases.title: Event Detail & Ticket Selection
phases.objective: Explore the event page, audio clips, and ticket tier selection logic.
key_checks: Play/pause audio clips to check media controls.
Select 'VIP' tier and verify 'SELLING FAST' badge and price point ($52).
Use stepper to increase quantity to 2 tickets.
Verify sticky 'Your Order' summary updates subtotal and fees dynamically.
Click 'Continue to checkout'.
exit_criteria: Order summary reflects correct base price.

phases.title: Checkout Flow & Form Logic
phases.objective: Complete the attendee and payment forms, testing edge cases like VIP fields and data copying.
key_checks: Verify 10-minute countdown timer is visible.
Fill Buyer Info (First/Last/Email).
Expand Attendee 2 form; use 'Copy buyer info' and verify fields populate.
Locate and fill 'Name for signed poster' field (specific to VIP tickets).
Enter invalid promo code, then valid code (DOORS5) and verify fee reduction in breakdown.
Select Payment Method and enter dummy card details (checking formatting).
exit_criteria: Promo discount applied in fee breakdown.

phases.title: Confirmation & Recovery
phases.objective: Submit the order and verify the success state, then test cancellation/recovery.
key_checks: Submit order and verify redirect to confirmation.html.
Validate order details on confirmation page match checkout inputs.
Return to checkout.html (via back nav or new session).
Test 'Cancel' button and verify second-confirmation dialog appears.

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness Check
phases.objective: Repeat critical path interactions on mobile viewport to assess touch usability.
key_checks: Switch to mobile viewport.
Re-test filtering on index.html (check for overlap/usability).
Re-test ticket stepper on event.html (ensure buttons are tappable).
Re-test checkout form inputs (verify keyboard triggers and layout stacking).
Specifically target previously identified small tap targets (nav links) to document difficulty.
exit_criteria: Critical flows completed on mobile viewport.
Usability issues noted for small tap targets.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 4 HTML files (index, event, checkout, confirmation).
coverage_targets.features: Exercise filters, audio players, ticket steppers, promo codes, copy-info logic, and payment form.
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat Phase 1, 2, and 3 key interactions on mobile viewport.

notes: Prescan identified multiple 'small_tap_target' warnings on index.html nav items; prioritize documenting these in Phase 5.
The README mentions a 'Cancel second-confirmation'; ensure this modal/dialog is triggered in Phase 4.
Fee breakdown includes specific line items (Service $3.50, Facility $2, Processing 3% + $0.30); visually verify these math components in Phase 3.
